meta.name: ad-angle-miner
meta.description: Find the ad angles worth running, then turn them into what the user asked for: copy angles only, video ad ideas, or static ad ideas. Mines customer language (reviews, Reddit, social comments, support tickets) and competitor ads, and for video or static also mines what is getting organic reach on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and X. Every reference is labelled paid or organic, so boosted "winners" are not copied. Outputs a ranked angle bank; for video and static, each angle comes with a creative (a format or template to make it with) and can be handed straight to making the ads.
